ebook-ai-sme.title: 1. AI as intern, not magic CEO
ebook-ai-sme.body: Use AI to draft, summarise, and brainstorm. You still decide quality, pricing, and customer promises. Never paste private customer data into public tools carelessly.

ebook-ai-sme.title: 2. High-ROI use cases for SMEs
ebook-ai-sme.body: WhatsApp reply drafts, product descriptions, content ideas, SOP first drafts, meeting summaries, and translating rough notes into client updates.

ebook-ai-sme.title: 3. Prompt patterns that save time
ebook-ai-sme.body: Give role, context, constraints, and format. Example: You are a polite salon receptionist in Lagos. Write 3 WhatsApp replies offering Saturday slots under Naira X. Tone: warm, short.

ebook-ai-sme.title: 4. Content without sounding robotic
ebook-ai-sme.body: Always edit AI output with your voice, local price cues, and real examples. Add one personal line only a human would know.

ebook-ai-sme.title: 5. Customer support assist
ebook-ai-sme.body: Build a private FAQ doc and ask AI to answer only from it. Hallucinated policies create refunds.

ebook-ai-sme.title: 6. Ops and checklists
ebook-ai-sme.body: Turn tribal knowledge into SOPs: opening shop, closing, refunds, delivery. AI drafts; you verify once; staff follow.

ebook-ai-sme.title: 7. Risks and boundaries
ebook-ai-sme.body: No legal or medical advice as if expert. No fake reviews. No deepfake marketing of clients. Protect API keys and billing on AI accounts.

ebook-ai-sme.title: 8. 30-day adoption plan
ebook-ai-sme.body: Week 1: replies and captions. Week 2: SOPs. Week 3: product copy. Week 4: measure hours saved and errors. Keep what works; drop the rest.

ebook-one-page-marketing.title: 1. Strategy on one page
ebook-one-page-marketing.body: If your plan needs a 40-slide deck, you will not execute it. One page: audience, offer, channels, weekly actions, budget, metric.

ebook-one-page-marketing.title: 2. Who exactly buys
ebook-one-page-marketing.body: Pick one primary customer. Write their job, fear, desire, and where they already pay attention. Secondary audiences wait until primary works.

ebook-one-page-marketing.title: 3. Message house
ebook-one-page-marketing.body: One core promise, three supporting proofs, one CTA. Repeat everywhere: site, status, ads, packaging.

ebook-one-page-marketing.title: 4. Channel choice
ebook-one-page-marketing.body: Pick two: e.g. WhatsApp status + Instagram, or Google Business + referrals. Depth beats dabbling.

ebook-one-page-marketing.title: 5. Weekly rhythm
ebook-one-page-marketing.body: Block time for create, engage, sell, review. Marketing dies when it is only when we remember.

ebook-one-page-marketing.title: 6. Budget without waste
ebook-one-page-marketing.body: Boost only posts that already get organic saves or comments. Track cost per chat and cost per sale, not vanity likes.

ebook-one-page-marketing.title: 7. Simple metrics
ebook-one-page-marketing.body: Chats started, booked jobs, revenue, repeat rate. Screenshot weekly numbers into a folder.

ebook-one-page-marketing.title: 8. Quarterly reset
ebook-one-page-marketing.body: Kill channels that do not pay. Double down on what does. Update the one-pager; throw away the old one.

ebook-cash-first.title: 1. Profit is not cash in the account
ebook-cash-first.body: You can be profitable on paper and still unable to buy stock. Track cash weekly: opening balance, in, out, closing.

ebook-cash-first.title: 2. Separate pots
ebook-cash-first.body: Operating, tax, owner pay, and growth. Even if one bank account, label balances mentally or with sub-ledgers.

ebook-cash-first.title: 3. Pricing for cash reality
ebook-cash-first.body: Include payment delays, transfer fees, and returns. Prefer deposits for custom work.

ebook-cash-first.title: 4. Collections discipline
ebook-cash-first.body: Invoice same day. Remind on schedule. Pause work when unpaid beyond agreed terms.

ebook-cash-first.title: 5. Expense diet
ebook-cash-first.body: List every monthly debit. Cut or renegotiate the bottom 20% that does not produce sales or required compliance.

ebook-cash-first.title: 6. Stock and inventory cash traps
ebook-cash-first.body: Dead stock is frozen cash. Buy what turns. Count inventory monthly.

ebook-cash-first.title: 7. Emergency buffer
ebook-cash-first.body: Aim for 4 to 8 weeks of fixed costs. Build it automatically on good weeks.

ebook-cash-first.title: 8. Weekly cash meeting
ebook-cash-first.body: Same day each week: balances, upcoming bills, expected inflows, one action to improve cash.

ebook-founder-habits.title: 1. Energy is a business asset
ebook-founder-habits.body: Sleep, food, and movement affect decisions. Founders who run on chaos make expensive mistakes.

ebook-founder-habits.title: 2. Time blocks that survive reality
ebook-founder-habits.body: Protect a daily Make block (delivery), Sell block (outreach), Admin block (money/messages). Batch WhatsApp instead of living inside it.

ebook-founder-habits.title: 3. One MIT (Most Important Task)
ebook-founder-habits.body: Each morning pick one task that makes the day a win if nothing else finishes. Do it before shallow work.

ebook-founder-habits.title: 4. Environment design
ebook-founder-habits.body: Phone out of hand during deep work. Templates for repeated tasks. Default calendar holds.

ebook-founder-habits.title: 5. Review rituals
ebook-founder-habits.body: Daily 10-minute shutdown. Weekly 30-minute review of numbers and pipeline.

ebook-founder-habits.title: 6. Saying no
ebook-founder-habits.body: Every yes is a no to something else. Decline politely with a referral or a future date.

ebook-founder-habits.title: 7. Health minimums
ebook-founder-habits.body: Walk, water, protein, stretch. Non-negotiable floors beat perfect gym plans you abandon.

ebook-founder-habits.title: 8. Identity over motivation
ebook-founder-habits.body: You are someone who ships and follows up. Motivation follows identity and evidence.
